name: Agents·Index

sources.title: Submit a listing — 'Sign in or create a free account, then share your website for review'; 131 agents indexed; separate /claim route for already-listed products
Pricing — 'Get listed free'; paid extras: Featured $12/mo, Premium $25/mo, Website link $99/yr (the only dofollow link), Primary Source $49 one-time, commission a brief $349

conditions: Listing itself is free but requires creating a free account (no card) and passes a quality gate — 'researched listings' with editorial review; not a self-serve instant publish
If the product is already in the index, use /claim and verify a connection to its domain instead of submitting
requirements: AI agents and the agent stack only: coding, support, sales/marketing, research/data, voice, legal agents, agent frameworks, platforms, tools/infrastructure, and agencies/build partners
A generic SaaS that is not an AI agent does not fit — categories are agent-specific
Account required; submission is reviewed ('share your website for review')
preparation: Product URL and description; pick the right agent category (10 defined categories)
If already indexed: claim via /claim with domain verification

Optional budget for extras: Featured $12/mo (category placement), Premium $25/mo (homepage+picks), Website link $99/yr (single dofollow link on your listing), Primary Source $49 one-time (publish 32 answered questions in your own words)
workflow: Create a free account at https://theagentsindex.com/submit
Share the product website for review (or claim an existing listing via /claim)
Wait for editorial review — the index is curated ('datasheet' style: specs, price, whether it holds under load)
Once published, optionally buy placement or the Website link upgrade; claimers see listing analytics (views, clicks, referrals)
watchFor: Placement links are rel='sponsored nofollow' — the ONLY dofollow option is the $99/yr Website link on your own listing
Paying never changes inclusion, organic ordering, or editorial assessment — ads are labeled Advertisement
Editorial standards mean a listing includes honest cons — coverage is not guaranteed positive
Small index (131 agents) but actively maintained (updated Sep 26, 2026)
countsAsLive: A published listing page for the agent exists on theagentsindex.com under its category with specs/pricing datasheet fields
unknowns: Review turnaround time for free submissions
Whether the free listing's outbound link is nofollow (paid Website link suggests default is not followed)
